2: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah; set to Alamoth. A Song. God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
3: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;
4: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. [Selah
5: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.
6: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.
7: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.
8: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah
9: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.
10: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.
11: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
12: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah
